identity: Unit serial, battery SKU/lot/history, PCB and case revisions, firmware binary SHA256 and configuration, recipient public key fingerprint
Instrument model/calibration, measurement wiring, shunt burden and sampling interval, ambient and battery temperature, charging termination and rest interval
startup_diagnostic: Separate diagnostic run: read RCC SYSCLK source and HCLK after startup, MSISON/MSISRDY cleared, MSIK enabled when audio starts; verify audio and RNG/USB after clock change.
Store diagnostic evidence separately; diagnostic run cannot substitute for the normal-build battery acceptance run.
capture: Record the independent clock time when capture actually begins; button time or USB removal alone is not a capture-start measurement.
Play a reproducible source with unique time-coded markers and scheduled quiet intervals, retaining the exact source file/hash, playback timing log and independent reference capture.
Source and recorder clocks are independent: estimate sample-clock drift from markers throughout the run. Do not impose exactly 921600000 samples as an unqualified wall-clock equivalence.

Before the run, fix marker cadence, detection algorithm, timing uncertainty, acceptable sample-rate tolerance and the smallest detectable discontinuity. These values remain unresolved; do not choose them after viewing results.

Keep the recorder on its specified battery without USB/debugger/back-power for at least 57600 seconds of actual capture. Include startup and saving energy; retain raw current/voltage/temperature logs.
At the end, preserve recordings through normal stop/finalization and record the time. A partial final chunk must not silently count as stored audio.
verification: Import and decrypt every recording, retaining encrypted originals and hashes. Record import/decryption errors rather than skipping failed files.
Check file ordering, sequence identifiers where available, actual decoded sample rate/channel count and sample totals, and inspect every file boundary for missing or repeated source markers.
Fit external marker time to decoded sample position and examine residuals for discontinuities, drift changes and duplication; retain per-marker results and alignment uncertainty.

Verify quiet periods remain on the recorded timeline. Absence of markers in true silence prevents acoustic proof of a sub-interval dropout; combine decoded counts/sequence metadata with firmware capture evidence, and report the remaining detection limit.

Require recoverable audio spanning at least 57600 real seconds, including quiet intervals, with no detected gaps/duplicates/corruption under the predeclared detection limits. Current-trace duration alone cannot pass R16.
unresolved_before_execution: Time-code stimulus and detector implementation/validation, including clock drift and dropout/duplication injection
Permitted audio sample-clock tolerance and continuity detection resolution
Method to establish actual capture start/end without altering acceptance firmware power
Measurement burden and logging coverage limits
